thread:
alice: Deploybot shows rollout v4.2.2 -> prod done at 2026-11-02T10:01:52Z. Quick synth in us-east shows heartbeat p95 up to ~140ms. KV probe green. Anyone onwatch?

deploy-bot: rollout v4.2.2 completed (rollout_id=rl-cc7) :white_check_mark:

bob: saw it. p50 stable, tails moved. running quickcheck now.

carla: FYI I landed a small tokenizer change in this patch.

bob: quickcheck cmd: `./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --region us-east --window 8m`
Output: p50=48ms, p95=136ms, p99=210ms, errors=0.06%

alice: low errors so not full rollback. Suggest pin us-east to v4.2.1 for 15m while we run synth and tokenizer bench.

carla: agree. pin variant for 15m to get traces. I'll update release notes.

bob: pinning: `redwood route pin --region us-east --variant v4.2.1 --duration 15m --reason "postdeploy heartbeat tail"`

ops-bot: route pin applied (us-east -> v4.2.1) by bob at 2026-11-02T10:07:10Z. TTL 15m.

bob: kicked off expanded synth: `./ops/smoketest --profile long-tail --region us-east --duration 10m`

alice: post-pin quickcheck (5m): p95=98ms, p99=150ms, errors=0.02% -> much better.

carla: tokenizer bench shows v4.2.2 tokenize p95 +25ms on long contexts vs v4.2.1. Link: https://internal/perf/tokenize/20261102-diff

alice: decision: keep pin and block global rollout in us-east, patch tokenizer and release v4.2.3. Update release notes and notify CS. If post-patch checks green, unpin and resume.

ops-bot: pin TTL expiring in 2m.

bob: pin expired, unpinning: `redwood route unpin --region us-east --variant v4.2.1`

ops-bot: route pin removed by bob at 2026-11-02T10:22:12Z.

alice: post-unpin quickcheck: p95=105ms, p99=160ms, errors=0.04%. Monitoring for 1h, but proceeding with tokenizer patch plan. Closing thread unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
